attributes.name: Celestial Crossbow +3
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+3. If proficient with weapons, you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8. If the check is against a bane that has the Demon, Devil, Fiend, or Undead trait, add another 2d6 and the Fire or Force trait.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4+2 and the Divine trait to a combat check by a character at another location.
